edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, giving the deployer full privileged control.
finishBet forwards msg.sender as the settlement target.
_playerRollDice requires _zthToken(msg.sender), trusting caller identity as the token contract.
_betSize feeds the betIsValid range check before rolling.
_playerNumber feeds the betIsValid range check before rolling.
_tkn supplies the bettor address and wager value to _playerRollDice.
_rollUnder is packed into the stored playerRoll struct.
_playerRollDice writes the playerRoll struct into playerRolls.
_finishBet reads the stored bet via playerRolls[target].
_finishBet clears playerRolls[target] to block re-entrant double settlement.
delete playerRolls[target] is executed before the external payout transfer.
Winning branch reduces the tracked balance with contractBalance.sub(profit).
Losing branch increases the tracked balance with contractBalance.add(roll.tokenValue).
sub result is written back into contractBalance.
add result is written back into contractBalance.
_finishBet calls calculateProfit to derive the payout.
calculateProfit performs raw multiplication and division on bet values.
_initBet is the multiplicand of the profit formula.
_roll determines the divisor of the profit formula.
setMaxProfit reads contractBalance to recompute the payout cap.
maxProfit is recomputed as contractBalance * percent / divisor.
_finishBet performs an external token transfer while settling the bet.
An ERC223 token transfer re-enters tokenFallback on a contract recipient.
tokenFallback can call _playerRollDice from within the payout callback.
finishBet delegates settlement to _finishBet.
dumpdivs performs an ETH transfer to the bankroll contract.
The bankroll contract receiving ETH can re-enter the payable fallback.
dumpdivs targets the stored ZethrBankroll address.
ownerkill executes selfdestruct(owner).
selfdestruct sends the remaining balance to the current owner.
ownerTransferZTH performs an external token transfer to an arbitrary address.
Constructor approves an unlimited allowance to the bankroll.
ownerSetBankroll revokes then re-grants unlimited allowance.
Constructor sets the owner from the caller address.
ownerChangeOwner reassigns the owner state variable.
